cross_item_pattern.rule: In an item asking which procedure would best test or isolate an effect (or why one factor was held fixed), the key is the only option in which exactly one condition differs and the comparison group named in the stem is kept; every distractor changes a second condition, drops the comparison group, or tests a substance/variable other than the one the stem names. Applied without the passage it picks the key on all three named items. Caveat: this is generic control-of-variables logic, the construct Scientific Investigation items test; the coordinator may judge it construct-aligned rather than a brief-induced tell. The same items are flagged item-level (no_source_needed, free_elimination).
